name: Theta-Class Hypergraph and Theta-Graph Profile
statement: For an ACC graph, the 2-section of $\mathcal H_\Theta(G)$ is chordal. In a median graph every pairwise adjacent family of $\Theta$-classes has representatives with a common endpoint, so $\omega(\Theta(G))=\Delta(G)$. If $G$ is both ACC and a $p$-expansion graph, then $\mathcal H_\Theta(G)$ is conformal and $\Theta(G)$ is dually chordal. For every $p$-expansion graph, $\Theta(G)$ is chordal; hence it is doubly chordal in the ACC case.
comments: The ACC hypothesis alone does not force conformality or dual chordality; the source supplies a counterexample.
